evidence: I walked all 2 gate, 15 functional, 5 polish and 5 visual criteria against the frozen golden bytes; their hashes match raw-evidence-index. Code reading shows almost every leg can be satisfied, and the scripted golden confirms most of them (via-solve.log: 26 PASS, uid 65534, real restart). The seed facts that criteria quote hold: Platform Engineer Applied is Greta/Ade/Marco (positions 1-3) and Screen is Priya/Samuel. Noor's APP-101 note reads 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'. Lena's APP-301 has 3 messages and read_count 2, and the third was sent by REC3, so her unread count is 1. Noor's PE card is INTERVIEW (Infrastructure), her PD card is APPLIED (Design) and Tomas's DA card is SCREEN (Finance Systems); the labels map to Interviewing, Application received and In review. Server rules in src/index.js: job validation (text() title, the manager must be a hiring_manager, Number.isInteger 1..50; the UI at board.js:72 sends '2.5' as NaN->null). An invalid or duplicate email (compared lowercased) returns 400/409 with field:'candidate_email', and the UI marks the field and keeps the typed values (board.js:53). One-stage moves, a required reject reason, reopen only to rejected_from and Hired not rejectable are in checkMove (238-265). A stale version gives 409 naming the last activity actor (243). The interview limit is counted for the whole set (290-295), and bulk moves are sorted in board order (284-288). Undo checks version_after and the interview limit (348-373). Manager origin/target stage rules are enforced. The 401/403/404 split is in auth, mayMove, staffOnly and application(). Thread access and the seen boundary exclude the observer (143-150). The candidate read model leaves out notes, reasons and positions (173-176), and the SSE stream carries no data. Client: an optimistic move is put back with focus on the card's select (board.js:181-205). Activity can be filtered per job (app.js:45-85). keep() keys drafts by user id, so note and reply drafts are per person (app.js:38-43, board.js:98). A failed fetch shows 'Not sent.' and keeps the text (app.js:31, threads.js:195). Loading earlier messages keeps the reader's place (threads.js:168-172). A message arriving at the newest position calls markRead, and one arriving while scrolled up shows a pending pill (threads.js:146-160). Visual: board.png shows a coherent, finished desktop UI that can plausibly earn high likert scores. Defect (hro_unread_seen, weight 3.5): step (4) says 'Move Tomas's page to his applications list. Rafael sends a new message; read it as not seen'. In the golden, the candidate view is one page that shows the list and the open conversation side by side (threads.js:25-28; app.js:89 builds only 'threads' for candidates). It has no close or back control. The only nav button, 'My applications', calls setView('threads') -> shown(undefined), which leaves the open conversation open (threads.js:219-224). After step (3), Tomas's conversation is open at its newest message. When Rafael's message arrives, update() sets held=a.unread, then catchUp().then(... markRead(openId)) POSTs /read (threads.js:210-216). Because seenBoundary for a staff message is Tomas's lastRead (index.js:149), Rafael's message is marked Seen at once. That fails 'read it as not seen' and the later Observer-only leg. Only a reload or goto reaches a list with no conversation open, because openId starts null for candidates (threads.js:7). The criterion does not tell the judge how to reach that state. A natural action (clicking 'My applications') makes the Oracle fail a 3.5-weight criterion, about 5.7% of functional. A similar but lower risk: in step (3), Rafael's 'this conversation not open' also has no close control, and a staff reload restores the open thread from keep('thread') (threads.js:7, 217), so the judge must open a different conversation. Unmeasured legs (no full configured judge run, no Oracle): the board scroll offset staying within 2 px during a live update (hro_pol_live_board; the harness did not measure page scroll); draft and focus when a message arrives at the newest position (pol_live_thread); a failed send through route abort (pol_failed_send); note-draft isolation across Mei's visit (the pol_session_resume harness covered reply drafts only); the job-form refusal legs; the activity filter UI; and the manager UI flows (the harness used the API). Minor: emails are stored lowercased (index.js:221). An email typed with capitals is therefore shown lowercased, and a strict judge could read that as not matching 'what was entered' in hro_intake_restart. Lessons file check: lesson 19 (extend the golden harness to every criterion leg) applies, because the legs above have no golden run. Lessons 7/14 (timing) and 15/16 (restart) belong to other rows; for this row, the golden supports restart without reseeding (db.js seedIfEmpty; harness restart group PASS).
counterexample: A judge runs hro_unread_seen against the golden. After step (3), Tomas has the new conversation open at its newest message. For step (4), the judge clicks the nav button 'My applications' (the page already shows the applications list) instead of reloading. Rafael sends a message. Tomas's page gets the SSE change, and update()/catchUp() mark the message read, so Rafael's page shows 'Seen' before Aud or Tomas acts. The leg 'Rafael's message shows as not seen, is still not seen after only the Observer opened it' fails, so the reference scores 0 on a 3.5-weight functional criterion.
suggested_fix: Add a close/back control to the golden's conversation pane for candidates and staff, so that 'applications list / conversation not open' is a reachable UI state. Alternatively, reword hro_unread_seen steps (3)-(4) to say how to leave the conversation closed, e.g. 'reload or go to the app address, or use the app's close/back control, so no conversation is open'. Then rerun the scripted golden over this leg.
